summary: Retest for NEW FEATURE: Advanced Export & Document Enhancement (business report PDF/XLSX, professional invoice PDF, export audit history + Laporan UI). Added 2 new backend test files (8 tests) and 1 new browser check; re-ran all 7 pre-existing browser checks by name (no regressions) plus 1 through the public preview URL; re-ran the full backend suite for regression (51 passed, only the 3 known out-of-scope live-Gemini OCR tests failed, matching spec_deviations). All new-feature criteria pass.

action_items.note: Full-suite regression rerun: tests/test_tscheck_document_extraction.py, test_tscheck_document_validation.py, test_tscheck_duplicate_detection.py failed again with 502 'Gemini tidak dapat memproses dokumen ini' on the live Gemini OCR call. Matches spec_deviations ('Document OCR ... may intermittently 502 on first attempt — out of scope for this retest'). No application code issue identified; not part of this feature's criteria.
